units.source_text: 但是，就是在公共汽车上，我的脑子里还浮现着名人的形象。

en.t: But even on the bus, the image of the master still floated up in my mind.

units.source_text: 也许是对老名人产生的感情渗透了身心，才使我感到可亲可敬。

en.t: Perhaps the feelings I had developed for the old master had seeped through my body and mind, making him seem both dear and worthy of respect.
